description: This file contains the implementation of the hiredis C client library for Redis, including functions for creating and freeing reply objects, formatting commands, managing Redis connections, and handling I/O operations. It defines internal structures, external dependencies, and functions for command serialization, reply parsing, and connection management, with specific focus on Redis protocol handling.

methods.name: createReplyObject
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new redisReply object of a specified type.

methods.name: freeReplyObject
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a redisReply object, including nested elements.

methods.name: createStringObject
methods.description: Creates a string reply object, handling special cases like verbatim replies.

methods.name: createArrayObject
methods.description: Creates an array reply object with specified number of elements.

methods.name: createIntegerObject
methods.description: Creates an integer reply object with a given value.

methods.name: createDoubleObject
methods.description: Creates a double reply object with a string representation.

methods.name: createNilObject
methods.description: Creates a NIL reply object.

methods.name: createBoolObject
methods.description: Creates a boolean reply object with a specified value.

methods.name: redisvFormatCommand
methods.description: Formats a Redis command string with variable arguments according to protocol.

methods.name: redisFormatCommand
methods.description: Public API to format a Redis command string with printf-like syntax.

methods.name: redisFormatSdsCommandArgv
methods.description: Formats a command into an SDS string with given arguments.

methods.name: redisFreeSdsCommand
methods.description: Frees an SDS command string.

methods.name: redisFormatCommandArgv
methods.description: Formats a command into a string with argument arrays.

methods.name: redisFreeCommand
methods.description: Frees a command string.

methods.name: __redisSetError
methods.description: Sets error code and message in redisContext.

methods.name: redisReaderCreate
methods.description: Creates a new Redis reply parser.

methods.name: redisPushAutoFree
methods.description: Callback to automatically free push reply objects.

methods.name: redisContextInit
methods.description: Initializes a new redisContext with default functions and structures.

methods.name: redisFree
methods.description: Frees all resources associated with a redisContext.

methods.name: redisFreeKeepFd
methods.description: Frees redisContext but returns its file descriptor.

methods.name: redisReconnect
methods.description: Attempts to reconnect a Redis context based on its connection type.

methods.name: redisConnectWithOptions
methods.description: Creates a Redis connection with specified options.

methods.name: redisConnect
methods.description: Connects to Redis at given IP and port.

methods.name: redisConnectWithTimeout
methods.description: Connects to Redis with a specified timeout.

methods.name: redisConnectNonBlock
methods.description: Creates a non-blocking Redis connection.

methods.name: redisConnectBindNonBlock
methods.description: Creates a non-blocking Redis connection with source address binding.

methods.name: redisConnectBindNonBlockWithReuse
methods.description: Creates a non-blocking Redis connection with source address binding and reuse option.

methods.name: redisConnectUnix
methods.description: Connects to Redis via Unix socket.

methods.name: redisConnectUnixWithTimeout
methods.description: Connects to Redis Unix socket with timeout.

methods.name: redisConnectUnixNonBlock
methods.description: Creates a non-blocking Unix socket Redis connection.

methods.name: redisConnectFd
methods.description: Creates a Redis context from an existing file descriptor.

methods.name: redisSetTimeout
methods.description: Sets read/write timeout on a Redis connection.

methods.name: redisEnableKeepAlive
methods.description: Enables TCP keep-alive on a Redis connection.

methods.name: redisSetPushCallback
methods.description: Sets a callback for handling RESP3 push messages.

methods.name: redisBufferRead
methods.description: Reads data from socket and feeds it to the reply parser.

methods.name: redisBufferWrite
methods.description: Writes data from output buffer to socket.

methods.name: redisHandledPushReply
methods.description: Checks if reply is a RESP3 push message and handles it.

methods.name: redisGetReplyFromReader
methods.description: Retrieves a reply from the parser, setting error if needed.

methods.name: redisNextInBandReplyFromReader
methods.description: Gets next reply, handling push messages.

methods.name: redisGetReply
methods.description: Retrieves a reply, handling blocking and non-blocking modes.

methods.name: __redisAppendCommand
methods.description: Appends a command string to the output buffer.

methods.name: redisAppendFormattedCommand
methods.description: Appends a formatted command to the output buffer.

methods.name: redisvAppendCommand
methods.description: Appends a command with printf-like formatting.

methods.name: redisvCommand
methods.description: Sends a command and blocks for reply.

methods.name: redisCommand
methods.description: Sends a command with printf-like syntax and blocks for reply.

methods.name: redisCommandArgv
methods.description: Sends a command with argument array and blocks for reply.
